description:
50 miles long range and fat tire electric bike with 26" x 4" fat tires for adults.
Faster, Stronger, & More Fierce than Ever
The Perfect Balance of Power and Speed.Build for Bold Moves, Ready for Every Mile.Powered by a rated 750W/peak 2000W motor with 95Nm torque, ensuring smooth control and thrilling rides.
50 Miles of Range
A 960Wh semi-invisible battery powers up to 50 miles, perfect for daily commutes or extended adventures without range anxiety.
Smart LCD Display
The independent buttons for theelectronic horn, headlight and turn signalsmake your operation more concise. The large color screen display enables you to keep track of your cycling situation at any time.
180mm Hydraulic Disc Brakes
Thicker, durable hydraulic brakesdeliver precise, instant stoppingpower for safe, confident riding inany situation.
Full Suspension
Along with the front suspension, the horst-link suspension makes up Horizon’s full suspension system, which greatly reduces bump on uneven surfaces
Adjustable handlebar
The handlebar is adjustable to suit riders of different heights.
